conclusion: No arithmetic counterexample identified inside the declared normalized finite pair domain. Physical wrapper and exhaustive midpoint checks remain separate receipts.
reasoning: All binary16 midpoints including first subnormal tie 2^-25 and overflow tie 65520 are exactly F32. For normalized hi/lo, the low term cannot cross a half midpoint unless hi equals that midpoint; at equality its sign selects the side, and zero low uses quotient parity.

Exponent<102 is below the first half midpoint and exponent>=143 is beyond the overflow midpoint; normalized residual cannot bridge either boundary. Relevant shifts are 13 through24, within U32 shift range.

The independent oracle represents each finite F32 exactly as integer multiples of2^-149 using BigInt. It sums both components without Number/F64 cancellation, binary searches exact half values, compares integer distances and uses ties-to-even.
Virtual positiveHalf[0x7c00]=65536 is intentional: its halfway boundary with65504 is65520, producing infinity encoding0x7c00 above or at the even overflow tie.

Signed zero is a representation policy: when both words are zero, preserve high sign, matching expansion(-0,+0). Added allfour signedzero combinations; nonzero exact cancellation is not a normalized pair.
limits: Does not validate caller normalization; public Tensor metadata proves layout, not numeric normalization.
Does not qualify arbitrary overlapping two-word pairs, nonfinite low components, model accuracy or performance.

Current boundary sweep covers every half midpoint and nearest three F32 highs with quarterULP residual signs, plus minimumsubnormal residual signs at each midpoint; it is not enumeration of all F32 pairs.
